quest.title: The Culling of the Worms: Testing
quest.description: You were unexpectedly attacked by a Wenut...

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: That was close... Even the Wenut have come to mess up our plan...

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Hey! If we hadn't deactivated the ignition, we could have killed it!

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Now that the Wenut has escaped, it'll be at least one more day before it lets its guard down again.

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: You're not planning to argue over the tiniest detail and let it go again tomorrow, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: Um, but what about the parameters...

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: I have tested them all, and although the charging speed is a little lower than the calculated value, it does not affect use, and there are no safety risks.

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Shriya, I know you want to consider and analyze everything before acting, but you know, things don't always go according to plan.

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: If you keep getting hung up over the small details, you'll miss the best opportunity to act! Remember that time our mid-term thesis defense got delayed? Hesitating won't get us anywhere.

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Alright! Tomorrow, we'll finally be able to put the Wenutslayer Cannon into action!

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: I'd like to bring them back to Aaru Village and tinker around with them a little more. We gotta make sure we're properly ready for the Wenutslayer Cannon's first ever official appearance!

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: ...But why is there a deviation in the environmental parameters? What caused the Wenut to suddenly act out?

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: #You really can't just let these matters rest... {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} Adventurer, could you please come back tomorrow?

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: By then, we should be facing the Wenut directly, and hopefully we'll have some sort of clue.
